room_rent.note: No room-rent restriction on base plan; optional Room Rent Modification can fix a category for lower premium

copayment.note: No mandatory base co-pay; optional Co-payment available for premium discount

deductible.note: Optional aggregate Deductible available for premium discount

ped_waiting.note: Reducible via optional PED Wait Period Modification; Instant Cover waives PED wait for Diabetes/HTN/Hyperlipidemia/Asthma

maternity.note: Maternity excluded (Excl18); New Born Cover available as optional benefit

cumulative_bonus.note: 50% flat SI/yr, capped at 100%; not forfeited on claim

restoration.note: Unlimited re-instatement of base SI per year, same or different illness

ambulance.note: Road ambulance up to SI; Air Ambulance optional

consumables.note: VERIFY — non-medical consumables cover not explicitly found in wording

global_cover.note: VERIFY — no overseas treatment cover found

optional_riders.display: Room Rent Modification, PED/Named-Ailment Wait Modification, Instant Cover, Deductible, Co-payment, New Born, Plus Benefit, Cumulative Bonus Super, Air Ambulance, Unlimited Care, Smart Select
